column3: A person shall be disqualified from being appointed

column2: or continuing as a member of the Board, if such person –

column3: is  or  becomes  a  Member  of  Parliament,  of  any
Provincial Council or of any Local Authority;
is not, or ceases to be, a citizen of Sri Lanka;
directly or indirectly holds or enjoys any right or
benefit under any contract made by or on behalf of
the Authority;
has any financial or other interest as is likely to affect
prejudicially the discharge by such person  of the
functions as a member of the Board;
absents himself from three consecutive meetings of
the Board, without obtaining prior approval of the
Board therefor;
is under any law in force in Sri Lanka or any other
country, found or declared to be of unsound mind;
is a person who having been declared as insolvent
or bankrupt under any law in force in Sri Lanka or in
any other country, is an undischarged insolvent or
bankrupt; or
is serving or has served a sentence of imprisonment
imposed  by  any  court  in  Sri  Lanka  or  any  other
country.
